name: Webhook HMAC check
audience: Developers who want a small, readable module they can drop into a Node.js project and modify.
summary: Compare a hex HMAC signature with the raw request body.
description: Computes HMAC-SHA256 over the exact body string and compares it in constant time when the lengths match. You pass the header secret. This is a generic check, not the signature scheme of a specific payment provider.
benefits: Plain JavaScript, no install step beyond Node.js
A test file you can run with node --test
No network calls and no hidden services
compatibility: Run npm test or node --test from this folder
disclaimer: These are small source files for you to read, test, and adapt. They are not a hosted service and they are not a security audit.
